mode.label: Mode
mode.manualHint: You choose the algorithm and reductions; the combination is validated before running.
mode.automaticHint: The system picks only certified (stable) methods and records the decision.
mode.noneHint: Runs the chosen algorithm without any reduction.
classic: Classic graph algorithm; no Petri-net-specific paper.
howItWorks: How it works, limits and references
doNotConclude: Do not conclude from this result
monotonicityBlocked: the required monotonicity does not hold for nets with inhibitors/immediate transitions.
reductionBlocked: is not valid for nets with inhibitors/immediate transitions.
title: Analysis algorithm
coverageNote: Coverability algorithms do not replace exact reachability.
extendedWarning: Net with inhibitor arcs/immediate transitions: only exact exploration (BFS/DFS) is valid; Karp–Miller, MinCov and reductions rely on monotonicity and are blocked.
noReductions: No reduction applies to this objective.
proposed: Proposed or under-study methods ({count}) — not selectable
doNotConcludeResult: Do NOT conclude from the result
reachabilityBlocked: Unavailable: the net is unbounded, so its reachability set is infinite.
reco.bounded: The net is bounded: its reachability set is finite, so the exact reachability graph can be computed.
reco.unbounded: The net is unbounded: its reachability set is infinite, so only the coverability analysis (ω-markings) applies.
reco.unknown: Boundedness is not established yet. Coverability decides it and always terminates, so it is preselected.
